title: CUDA-MPQS: a fully GPU-resident quadratic sieve - v1.0.6
description: CUDA-MPQS is a high-performance, fully GPU-resident implementation of the Self-Initializing Multiple Polynomial Quadratic Sieve (SIQS/MPQS) for integer factorization. The entire pipeline runs on the GPU: parameter tuning and autotuning, polynomial sieving, large-prime postprocessing, sparse GF(2) matrix construction and preprocessing, Block Wiedemann linear algebra, and the square-root stage. It runs on a single device or across a GPU cluster, and factors general composite integers of up to 512 bits.
